H-0727-05.note: UPS prints revenue, operating expenses and operating profit; it prints no gross-profit subtotal and the accession carries no GrossProfit fact.

H-1439-05.note: Oracle's statement of operations runs from total revenues straight to total operating expenses and operating income; no gross-profit row is printed and the accession carries no GrossProfit fact.

H-1800-05.note: Abbott's consolidated statement of earnings prints net sales, cost of products sold and operating earnings; gross profit appears only as a percentage in narrative, with no amount row and no GrossProfit fact.

H-4489-05.note: Disney's statement of income deducts costs and expenses from total revenues and reports segment operating income in a separate reconciliation; the statement prints no gross-profit row and the accession carries no GrossProfit fact.

H-8230-05.note: Neither the printed statements nor the accession's XBRL facts report gross profit; Caterpillar prints sales, operating costs and operating profit.
